sql: select x.v from (select v from t1) x;
select x.v from ((select v from t1)) x;
select x.v from (select v from (select v from t1) y) x;
select x.v from (select v from (select v from (select v from t1) a) b) x;
select (select v from t2) from t1;
select (select (select v from t3) from t2) from t1;
select v from t1 where v > (select v from t2);
select v from t1 where v + (select v from t2) > 1;
select v from t1 where (select v from t2) is null;
select x.v from (select v from t1 union all select v from t2) x;
select x.v from (select v from t1 order by v desc limit 1) x;
select x.v from (select v from t1 group by v having v > 1) x;
select a.v from (select v,id from t1) a join (select v,id from t2) b on a.id = b.id;
select a.v from (select v,id from t1) a left join t2 b on a.id = b.id;
select a.v from t1 a left join (select v,id from t2) b on a.id = b.id;
select cast((select v from t2) as int) from t1;
select coalesce((select v from t2), 1) from t1;
select if((select v from t2) > 1, 2, 3) from t1;
select case when (select v from t2) > 1 then 1 else 0 end from t1;
(select v from t1);
((select v from t1));
select v from (select v from t1 partition by c1) x;
select v from (select v from t1 interval(10s) sliding(5s)) x;
(select v from t1 union all select v from t2 order by v limit 1);
